messages.content: Follow the production contract exactly. Return valid JSON only.

AUTHORITATIVE CHAPTER SOURCE UNITS:
1. Amy cooks breakfast for Will and Amber.
2. A zombie breaks the kitchen door window; Amy gets Will and Amber into the basement and locks the door.
3. Amy retrieves her hidden pistol and katana and equips them.
4. The majority of the chapter is Amy fighting attacking zombies.
5. The larger zombie conflict remains unresolved when the chapter ends.

BEAT BUDGET: exactly 6.

Assign each beat to source-unit IDs only.
Every source unit must be represented.
Source unit 4 may occupy multiple beats because it is the majority of the chapter.
Do not write beat prose.

Return JSON with key beats; each beat object has beat and source_unit_ids only.
